# The documentation index prefers page-title order when no other ordering reason applies

The index comment describes a local fallback: use alphabetical page-title order when no other reason determines a toctree order. The owned patch moves the icons entry and adds the account guide. Preserve the explicit exception; this source study does not create or expand a deliberate writing rule.

Scope: Thunderbird source-tree documentation index.
